features.name: glucose_risk_tier
features.description: Ordinal bucket of plasma glucose into 4 clinically meaningful tiers: normal (<100), pre-diabetic (100-125), diabetic (126-199), severe (>=200). Higher tiers indicate greater metabolic risk.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides direct ordinal splits on the most predictive single feature, allowing tree to exploit known clinical thresholds without needing to rediscover them.

features.name: bmi_obesity_tier
features.description: Ordinal BMI category: underweight/normal (<25=0), overweight (25-29.9=1), obese class I (30-34.9=2), obese class II+ (>=35=3). Zero mass treated as missing-like and assigned tier 0.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes nonlinear BMI thresholds as ordinal integers, enabling tree splits at clinically meaningful obesity boundaries.

features.name: glucose_bmi_interaction
features.description: Product of plasma glucose and BMI, capturing joint metabolic burden. High values indicate co-occurring hyperglycemia and obesity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Nonlinear interaction term that tree models can split on to capture combined glucose-obesity risk that neither feature alone expresses.

features.name: age_pregnancy_burden
features.description: Ratio of number of pregnancies to age, reflecting reproductive burden relative to life stage. Higher values suggest more pregnancies per year of life.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures age-normalized pregnancy load; tree can split on high burden thresholds that may correlate with gestational diabetes history.

features.name: insulin_glucose_ratio
features.description: Ratio of insulin to plasma glucose, approximating insulin sensitivity. Low ratio with high glucose suggests insulin resistance. Zero insulin treated as 0 ratio.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes insulin resistance signal; tree splits on low ratio thresholds can identify metabolically compromised individuals.

features.name: high_glucose_flag
features.description: Binary indicator: 1 if plasma glucose >= 126 (diabetic threshold), 0 otherwise. Provides a direct boolean split at the clinical diabetes diagnosis boundary.
features.expected_model_benefit: Boolean feature enables a single clean split at the most clinically relevant glucose threshold, reducing tree depth needed to isolate high-risk cases.

features.name: obese_and_high_glucose
features.description: Boolean interaction: 1 if both BMI >= 30 and glucose >= 126, capturing the high-risk co-occurrence of obesity and hyperglycemia.
features.expected_model_benefit: Conjunctive boolean feature that tree models cannot easily reconstruct from individual splits alone; directly flags the highest-risk metabolic profile.

features.name: pedigree_log_scaled
features.description: Log1p-transformed diabetes pedigree function score, compressing the right-skewed distribution to improve tree split quality on genetic risk.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces skew in pedigree scores so tree splits are more evenly distributed across the genetic risk spectrum rather than concentrated at low values.

features.name: age_tier
features.description: Ordinal age bucket: young adult (21-30=0), middle-aged (31-45=1), older adult (46-60=2), senior (>60=3). Captures nonlinear age-related risk escalation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ordinal encoding of age risk tiers allows tree to split at meaningful life-stage boundaries rather than arbitrary numeric thresholds.

features.name: skin_bmi_ratio
features.description: Ratio of skin fold thickness to BMI, indicating subcutaneous fat distribution relative to overall body mass. Deviations may reflect atypical fat distribution patterns.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures fat distribution pattern beyond BMI alone; tree can split on extreme ratios indicating unusual adiposity profiles.

features.name: metabolic_risk_score
features.description: Holistic semantic score (0-4) assessing combined metabolic risk from glucose, BMI, age, and pedigree. Score increments: +1 for glucose>=126, +1 for BMI>=30, +1 for age>=45, +1 for pedigree>=0.5. Reflects multi-factor risk accumulation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregated risk count provides a single ordinal feature capturing multi-domain risk; tree can split at thresholds like score>=2 to identify high-risk individuals efficiently.

features.name: blood_pressure_deviation
features.description: Absolute deviation of diastolic blood pressure from the training-set mean (67.9 mmHg), capturing both hypo- and hypertensive anomalies. Zero pressure values (likely missing) produce large deviations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Flags abnormal blood pressure in either direction; tree splits on high deviation can isolate individuals with cardiovascular irregularities associated with metabolic disease.
